corpus_binding.case_file_set_hash_construction: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines '<case_id> <raw_file_sha256>\n' for the 48 execution cases sorted lexicographically by case_id
corpus_binding.fixture_mutation_policy: Any fixture-byte change requires a new comparison profile and preregistration; native results never alter reference fixtures or expected values.

coordinate_contract.native_to_canonical_transform: coordinate = exact elapsed seconds from canonical_origin divided by 3600
coordinate_contract.canonical_to_native_transform: native timestamp = canonical_origin plus coordinate elapsed hours

calculation_oracle.oracle_source: the immutable expected object in each bound fixture
calculation_oracle.null_rule: Expected null must remain null; absence, blank text and zero are not equivalent to null.
calculation_oracle.missing_field_rule: Any missing claim field is executed_fail.
calculation_oracle.extra_field_rule: Extra native fields are retained in evidence but cannot expand the claim.

approved_transformations.rule: exact affine conversion only; no rounding or snapping

approved_transformations.input: native relationship, constraint, task and calendar fields
approved_transformations.output: canonical enum/value fields listed in source_preservation_fields
approved_transformations.rule: the raw-to-normalized mapping must be frozen in the pre-execution case-realization manifest; unlisted mappings are forbidden

calculation_oracle.post_hoc_explanation_rule: A narrative explanation cannot convert an unlisted transformation or mismatched claim field into a pass.

execution_tracks.purpose: Test the bounded native Microsoft Project calculation after a preregistered manual native realization.
execution_tracks.manual_transcription_controls: Two-person field verification plus screenshots or native reports and a hashed normalized extract are required.

execution_tracks.purpose: Test save, close, reopen and native Microsoft Project recalculation stability for the same native file.
execution_tracks.manual_transcription_controls: The same controlled extraction method used before close must be repeated after reopen and recalculation.

execution_tracks.purpose: Test only the bounded MSPDI XML adapter/interchange subset; this is not an MPP or production round-trip claim.

outcome_rules.native_semantic_subset_pass: Every claim-eligible case passes manual_native_semantic_parity with every comparison field exact after only approved transformations.
outcome_rules.reopen_stability_subset_pass: Every claim-eligible case passes saved_file_reopen_recalculate_stability with byte identities recorded and exact normalized field equality.
outcome_rules.adapter_interchange_subset_pass: Every claim-eligible case passes adapter_interchange_round_trip with zero changed claim fields and no manual transcription.
outcome_rules.characterization_rule: Characterization-only cases require complete evidence records but never count toward a compatibility, parity or interchange pass.
outcome_rules.difference_rule: Any claim-field difference is executed_fail unless an approved transformation in this profile produces exact equality.
outcome_rules.missing_evidence_rule: Missing required metadata or artifacts is executed_inconclusive, never pass.
outcome_rules.inaccessible_rule: Unavailable lawful product access is not_accessible and leaves every affected gate open.
outcome_rules.manual_intervention_rule: Any unpreregistered edit after initial native calculation is executed_fail; every permitted construction action remains evidence.

claim_boundary.maximum_native_semantic_claim: Exact agreement for the named Microsoft Project edition/build/configuration and the 45 claim-eligible reference-v0.3 microcases under microsoft-project-semantic-comparison-profile-v0.1.
claim_boundary.maximum_reopen_stability_claim: Exact save/reopen/recalculate stability for the named Microsoft Project edition/build/configuration and the same bounded subset.
claim_boundary.maximum_interchange_claim: Exact bounded MSPDI XML interchange agreement for the named edition/build/configuration and claim fields that actually passed the adapter track.
